data.body: [P2] Require the child wait to retain its operation ID across resume. The STARTED expectation, terminal expectation, and continuation-link selector all accept any `durable.operation.id`. Changing only the terminal wait's operation ID therefore leaves the assertions satisfied, allowing broken logical-operation correlation to pass case 27. Compare the terminal ID with the linked initial segment, or bind the child wait ID from service history and reuse it throughout. Add a regression with mismatched segment IDs.
